subject: AWS Offer tiles + co-sell enablement playbook — final review

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@cloudcorp.com>
Cc: Marcus Li <marcus.li@cloudcorp.com>, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: AWS Offer tiles + co-sell enablement playbook — final review

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for walking through the offer earlier this week. Attached are the updated product tiles for the AWS listing and an initial NA co-sell enablement playbook that your GTM team can use during joint outreach. High-level asks:

- Can you confirm that the pricing blurb on tile 2 is procurement-friendly (we softened the language per your request)?
- Any legal/marketing compliance edits for the short benefit bullets?
- Do you want us to include a one-page technical appendix (AMI tag and entitlement examples) in the public listing or keep it gated for co-sell partners only?

Attachments: redwood-aws-offer-tiles-v2.pdf (3-up tiles), co-sell-playbook-draft-NA.docx (outline + sample email cadences).

If it helps, I can join a quick 20-min sync with Marcus and your GTM lead to finalize before we submit the offer to AWS. Proposed times below (PST): Mon 9/14 11:00 or Tue 9/15 09:30.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Senior Partner Lead, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0122

From: Samantha Lee <samantha@cloudcorp.com>

Cc: Marcus Li <marcus.li@cloudcorp.com>, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 15:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: AWS Offer tiles + co-sell enablement playbook — final review

Hi Naomi —

Appreciate the fast turnaround — this looks close. Quick notes after a few passes:

- Tile copy: please replace "instant scale" with "elastic capacity" on tile 1. Our procurement/legal flagged the word "instant" as a claim they want to avoid.
- Pricing blurb on tile 2 is good but can we add a parenthetical: "(usage-based billing via AWS Marketplace)" so buyers know the transaction flow.
- For the technical appendix: keep AMI/entitlement examples gated — our security team prefers that for now. We can add a one-page summary to the public page that points to the gated appendix after registration.

Marcus will coordinate the legal redline for any remaining compliance language; he copied the procurement alias so they have visibility.

I can do Mon 9/14 11:00 PST — that works for our GTM lead.

Thanks,
Samantha
Head of Cloud Partnerships, CloudCorp
samantha@cloudcorp.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: AWS Offer tiles + co-sell enablement playbook — final review

Folks — forwarding CloudCorp's notes (below). Key internal edits before Monday's sync:

- Replace "instant scale" => "elastic capacity" across the tiles and hero. (Ben, can you push this into the design file and regenerate PNGs?)
- Add parenthetical pricing flow text to tile 2: "(usage-based billing via AWS Marketplace)" (Karthik, please confirm this copy aligns with the SKU/AMI mapping; we need to avoid implying AWS-managed billing if procurement requires a private offer.)
- Keep AMI appendix gated; add a one-page public summary that links to a gated asset. (Vanessa, can you draft the one-pager?)

Also: we should prepare a one-slide partner battlecard for the CloudCorp AE team and a 3-email cadence for co-sell outreach that mirrors the playbook. I'll take the cadence; Vanessa, will take the battlecard with you.

Quick timeline:
- Mon 9/14 11:00 PST sync with CloudCorp (I'll send a meeting invite)
- Finish tile PNGs + one-pager by EOD Mon so we can upload assets ahead of the AWS console submission Tues morning

Thanks — please flag blockers.

Naomi

Naomi/Team —

I'll take the tile edits this morning and regenerate the export. Two practical notes:

1) On the hero line we used an H1 that optimizes for clarity; swapping to "elastic capacity" is fine but we'll need to check how that affects the visual rhythm — I'll push a slightly condensed line-height so the hero stays tight.
2) For the pricing parenthetical, let's ensure we use the exact phrasing that AWS recommends: "(billed via AWS Marketplace)" — Karthik, can you confirm whether "usage-based billing via AWS Marketplace" or "billed via AWS Marketplace" is preferred for marketplace copy? If AWS requires the latter, we'll adopt their phrasing.

I'll attach the new PNGs to the drive folder once done and share the updated link in the calendar invite.

—Ben
Director, Product Marketing
ben.carter@redwood.com
